metadata.description: RAGAS evaluation dataset for P&ID Digital Assistant

test_cases.question: What is V-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: V-101 is the High Pressure Separator, a horizontal vessel used for separating gas from liquids in the gas processing facility.

test_cases.question: What is the design pressure of V-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: The design pressure of V-101 is 1200 PSIG at 300°F.

test_cases.question: What instruments are associated with V-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: V-101 has the following instruments: PSV-101 (Pressure Safety Valve), PT-101A/B/C/D (Pressure Transmitters), LT-101A/B (Level Transmitters), LIC-101A (Level Controller), and SDV-101 (Shutdown Valve).

test_cases.question: What is the function of PSV-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: PSV-101 is a Pressure Safety Valve that provides overpressure protection for V-101 (High Pressure Separator).

test_cases.question: What equipment is downstream of V-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: Downstream of V-101: the gas outlet goes to C-104 (Gas Compressor) and the liquid outlet goes to V-102 (Low Pressure Separator).

test_cases.question: What is C-104?
test_cases.ground_truth: C-104 is the Gas Compressor that receives gas from the High Pressure Separator (V-101) for compression.

test_cases.question: What is the operating pressure of V-101?
test_cases.ground_truth: The operating pressure of V-101 is 350 PSIG at 70°F.

test_cases.question: What is V-102 and what is its purpose?
test_cases.ground_truth: V-102 is the Low Pressure Separator that receives liquid from V-101 (High Pressure Separator) for further separation at lower pressure.
